failure_summary.description: Both answers included information already supplied by the clue instead of returning only the missing shared word or name component.

patch.reasoning: The skill already calls for minimal answers, but these failures show that agents are not applying that rule to completion clues and partial identifiers. A targeted answer-slot check clarifies how to return only the unknown component.

edits.content: - For completion or compound clues, identify the missing shared component that makes the alternatives fit; do not repeat a clue-supplied component or return one full compound. For partial-name prompts, give only the requested unknown name part. Before finalizing, omit components already stated in the question unless they are needed for unambiguous identification.
